_comment: Chinese display names for the rule pages (scripts/build_site.py): names only, never a value or a statement about a rule. tests/test_site.py requires one for every family, market, scope and rule that has a page (a unit without a name is written as its code).

rule.afrc_levy_each_side: 会财局交易征费（买卖双方）
rule.cat_fee_per_share: 综合审计追踪（CAT）费用（每股）

rule.investor_compensation_levy_each_side: 投资者赔偿征费（买卖双方）

rule.pattern_day_trader_min_equity: 日内交易者最低账户净值（PDT）

rule.retail_risk_disclosure_required: 个人投资者风险揭示书签署要求

rule.tick_size_table: 最小报价单位表（价位表）

rule.trading_tariff_per_trade: 交易系统使用费（每宗交易）
rule.transaction_levy_each_side: 证监会交易征费（买卖双方）
rule.vcm_trigger_pct: 市场波动调节机制（VCM）触发幅度
